Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: bind-protocol-mcp

The skill bundle is benign. The `SKILL.md` provides detailed, transparent instructions for the AI agent on how to install and interact with the Bind Protocol MCP server. It clearly distinguishes between local operations (where credential data never leaves the machine) and API-backed operations, explicitly stating that raw credentials remain local. It also provides sound security advice by warning against hardcoding API keys and recommending environment variables. There is no evidence of prompt injection to subvert the agent, exfiltrate data, or install backdoors; all instructions align with the stated purpose of providing a verifiable credential and zero-knowledge proof service.
